definitions.short: Jerocham , the name of seven or eight Israelites
definitions.full: H3395. (= a ?). 3 priests: a. 1Chr 9:12 , Ι ( ε ) ρααμ , etc. b. Neh 11:11 , Ι ( ε ) ροαμ . 4 father of a hero of David 1Chr 12:8 (van d.
